description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs - Notify the fees of documents issued by the Consular Division, under the Consular Functions Act
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Consular Functions Act, No. 4 of 1981, specifying new fees for various consular services. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of fees for legal/administrative services, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it names a minister, it does not involve government personnel changes (Type 2) or describe detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities (Type 3), but rather uses the minister's authority to enact a regulatory change.
